newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil diffs firm, low sulphur diesel scarce.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil diffs firm, low sulphur diesel scarce.

text.p: NWE gas oil premiums were firm on Friday in spite of an expected influx of U.S. cargoes, with strong demand for both heating oil and diesel soaking up product in the ARA region, traders said.
"It took me the whole day to find just 2KT (of 0.05 percent sulphur diesel)," said a major Rotterdam refiner.
On the barge market, a diesel parcel traded up $1 at Oct IPE +$18.50 fob Roterdam, while heating oil barges changed hands at Oct +$7 and +$7.50.
Demand for low sulphur diesel in France reamined strong after two cargoes were sold at firm levels on Thursday.
Russian material was also in short supply, with a cargo loading on Oct 15 at Ventspils traded at mean quotes -$7 fob, equivalent to $240 on today's prices.

Traders said that much of the 570,000 tonnes of U.S. gas oil fixed to head to Europe over the past two days could be swallowed up by deliveries against the IPE Oct contract, which expires next Thursday.
Oct IPE futures closed $1.25 down on the day at $245.50, but the Nov contract climbed to narrow the front-month backwardation to $10.
